text:
claire: Quick follow-up on the autoscaler RFC — was hoping to align on how preemption signals and right-sizing interact.

sam: Thanks. tl;dr: current autoscaler uses a soft headroom target + preemption-based reclaim. The question is when to triggger aggressive preempt vs let headroom float.

ying: From infra ops, we want to avoid cascading evictions during traffic spikes. My preference: favor temporary burst-credit draining before sending preempt signals.

matt: Agree with ying. Also want clear metrics: Preempt when node-level pressure > 90% for 30s AND tenant has no recent successful prewarm. Otherwise try reclaim via compress/kv-cache eviction.

claire: Proposed rules I sketched:
```
policy:
  target_headroom: 12%         # percent of GPUs kept free
  burst_credit_window: 5m
  preempt_threshold: 90%       # node util
  preempt_grace: 30s
  prefer_burst_before_preempt: true
```
Is this too prescriptive?

devon: The tricky part is multi-tenant fairness. If we always drain burst-credits first, noisy tenants can starve others by hoarding credits. Need a cross-tenant debit/credit settlement.

sam: Good point. We could add a rolling debit score. e.g., tenant_score = used_burst - allocated_burst * 0.8; if score > X then deprioritize for new burst grants.

ying: Also ops note: preemption signal path needs to be fast. We should avoid relying on k8s eviction API if it introduces variable latency. Use our allocator control-plane signal first, then fallback to kube evict.

matt: Implementation sketch for allocator API:
```
POST /allocator/v1/preempt
{ "node": "gpu-123", "policy": "gentle", "targets": ["tenant-A:slot-2"] }
```
Return: 200 + `drain_deadline`.
```

claire: Sounds reasonable. Open questions left:
- how to tune target_headroom vs cost
- how to compute tenant_score decay window
- safe defaults for on-prem vs hosted

devon: For defaults: hosted -> conservative (higher headroom), on-prem -> aggressive (lower headroom) because customers expect higher utilization.

sam: I'll spin up a small experiment: simulate 100 tenants, toggle prefer_burst_before_preempt, measure 99th p50 latency and eviction counts. Will share results by EOD Friday.

ops-bot: scheduled task created: `autoscaler-sim-run-1938007777` scheduled for 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC

claire: Thanks all — @sam, @ying can you coordinate on the allocator signal shape? I'll draft a short RFC addendum with the policy snippet and the experiments.

sam: on it. :thumbsup:
